buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Material of fabrication: - Electrolytic grade Copper of purity min 99.5% 2.All the materials required for fabricating the item as per Dwg. No. EASP/AH/ET/1/2026 will be under party ’s scope. 3. Before start of fabrication party has to supply Copper sample (min 1 Sq cm) for testing at APEP QC lab fr om the raw material lot identified for fabrication within one month from date of placement of contract. Part y has to submit material purity test report along with the sample 4.Fabrication to be started only after getting clearance of the raw material 5. Party has to fabricated and supply one number of copper rod as per Dwg. No. EASP/AH/ET/1/2026 from t he accepted raw material lot for dimensional inspection at APEP within 2 weeks from acceptance of raw m aterial 6. Fabrication of remaining copper rods to be done after getting clearance of the first copper rod. 7. Remaining machined copper rods are to be delivered within 1 month of acceptance of the first one num ber of machined copper rods 8. The copper rods should be within strict dimensional and geometrical tolerance as mentioned in the drawing. 9. Payment will be given after receipt, testing and acceptance of the item at APEP 10.
